entries.en: Know what? Get the feelin' this grime's what's really turnin' you on.

entries.en: Mmm, bet you see worse things in those shiny city apartments.

entries.en: I don't understand why we couldn't just stay in the car.

entries.en: Mmm, this place just reminds me of dates with the ex-wife. Same goes for your whining, actually.
